response.justification: Bogdan is a technically proficient senior individual contributor with relevant experience in distributed systems and some recent exposure to AI agent infrastructure. However, he is being evaluated for an executive CTO role that requires a proven track record of scaling engineering organizations (10 to 30+), developing a senior leadership layer, and operating at a strategic level. His resume shows no evidence of formal team leadership, people management, or experience in a senior executive capacity, making him a fundamental mismatch for the seniority and core leadership responsibilities of this position.
strengths: Deep experience with high-performance, low-latency microservices and distributed systems.
Broad technical skillset across multiple languages (Node.js, DLang, Java) and platforms.
Recent hands-on experience contributing to AI agent infrastructure and tooling.
concerns: Complete lack of demonstrated senior leadership or people management experience; all roles are senior individual contributors.
No evidence of scaling an engineering team, a hard requirement for the role.
Limited experience in fintech infrastructure and operating within regulated financial environments.
